title: Bounded constructible flat models under arbitrary finite scalar extension
statement: Let $T$ be a Noetherian scheme (quasi-compact and locally Noetherian), let $A\to B$ be a unital map of finite commutative rings, and let $a\le b$ be integers. Work in the ordinary constant-ring module derived categories on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Constructible sheaves mean finite locally constant modules on a finite constructible locally closed stratification [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf]. Let $K\in D^b(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ have constructible cohomology and Tor amplitude in $[a,b]$, meaning that $K\otimes^L_{A_T}M$ has cohomology only in $[a,b]$ for every degree-zero $A_T$-module sheaf $M$ [def-kun-tor-amplitude]. There exists a representing cochain complex $P$ of flat constructible $A_T$-module sheaves, zero outside $[a,b]$; flat means tensoring with the sheaf is exact [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules, def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. For every such representative $P$, both $P$ over $A_T$ and $P\otimes_{A_T}B_T$ over $B_T$ are K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex]. The latter complex represents $K_B=K\otimes^L_{A_T}B_T$ in the $B_T$-module derived category [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], with scalar action through its second factor; it has flat constructible terms and is zero outside $[a,b]$. Consequently $K_B$ is bounded constructible and has Tor amplitude in $[a,b]$. No flatness or finite projective dimension of $B$ over $A$ is assumed.

proof.text: Use the bounded-derived-category membership of K and its given finite-value constructible cohomology to form isBoundedConstructible. Apply [lem-sf-etale-flat-constructible] in the specified interval to obtain P, termwise flat and constructible, with its support and representing isomorphism.

For every such P, convert exactness of tensorRight into ObjectProperty.flat using the braiding. The support gives IsStrictlyGE a and IsStrictlyLE b. Apply the already proved source theorem CochainComplex.kFlat_of_bounded_of_flat (WeilConjectures.FromJoel.CategoryTheory.Abelian.Flat.KFlat) in the actual ModuleCat-valued sheaf category. Apply the already proved source theorem ProEtale.flat_etaleSheafExtendScalars_obj (WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.ProEtale.ScalarExtensionConstructible) to every term. Additive scalar extension sends zero objects to zero objects. The same bounded-flat theorem then gives K-flatness of the extended complex over B. No equivalence to a ring-sheaf module encoding is needed.
Apply the ordinary etale term and cohomology clauses of [lem-sp-constructible-coefficient-site-square] to P; its constructibleCoefficientComplex is definitionally the same termwise extension Q.

Use the constructed scalar derived adjunction of [def-weil-pbc-witness-compatibility]. Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq identifies the published pbcFixedScalarExtension with the total left derived functor of ordinary scalar extension. Its counit is invertible on the K-flat complex P by Functor.isIso_leftDerivedFunctorCounit_app_of_kFlat. Compose this counit with the homotopy-quotient/localization comparison isomorphisms and the scalar functor applied to Q(P) ≅ K. This gives K_B ≅ Q(Q) in the B-module derived category. The private construction is accessed by a proof-only import all; no public interface is changed.

Apply [lem-kun-flat-bounded-tor-amplitude] to the extended bounded flat complex Q. Its Tor interval implies the same cohomology interval by testing on the unit, so its localized object defines a bounded object. Transport the model isomorphism to obtain the bounded representative of K_B. Transport constructible cohomology using [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-etale-module-sheaf-comparison] and IsConstructibleSheaf.of_iso. Finally transport the Tor predicate by its closure under isomorphisms and convert to hasTorAmplitudeIn.

tool_uses.why: The finite-ring ordinary-etale specified-interval flat constructible model is the generic model input explicitly required by the coefficient-comparison unit; the pro-etale model alone would not supply its constructible etale terms.
Generic ringed-site bounded-above-flat K-flatness is applied on the small etale site; the coefficient-comparison unit contains no separate homological-algebra proof of this criterion.
Generic change of sheaf rings preserves flat-term K-flat complexes, providing target-ring flatness for a nonflat coefficient map without changing the unit route.
Only the underived ordinary-etale scalar constructibility and cohomology clauses are used; the same generic input is needed here without any use of its pro-etale comparison or six-functor operations.
The generic K-flat computation of ordinary derived coefficient extension identifies the actual object in the target-ring derived category; it implements the scalar extension used by the unit.
Generic bounded-flat-complex Tor-amplitude criterion, specialized to B on the small etale site, supplies the target interval without a new geometric route.
